svg.text: PostgreSQL target · UUID primary keys · crow's-foot relationships · composite tenant foreign keys enforce same-organization references
JSONB is reserved for editor block snapshots and opaque provider/audit payloads; repeating permissions, fields, list membership, and template variables are separate relations.
PK primary key · FK foreign key · UK unique candidate key · 1:N one-to-many · 0..1:N optional parent to many children · tenant copies are documented in 01_normalization.md
